item.title: Democrats vow to end Trump presidency if they win House
item.description: The top House Democrat said Thursday that Democrats would effectively end Trump's presidency if they win chamber control in the midterms.

item.title: Law firm sues Dearborn, Michigan, alleging discrimination favoring Islam
item.description: The complaint says courts have recognized a pattern of Dearborn favoring Islam over other religions, in violation of U.S. law.

item.title: Zara Larsson criticizes White House over ICE video using her song
item.description: Pop singer Zara Larsson criticized the White House for using her song in a video, calling those involved "such f-----g losers."

item.title: Why Trump's plan to stop noncitizens from rigging the census might work
item.description: The Trump administration proposed a rule change that could finally deliver on 'one man, one vote.'
